clauses.note: The documented predicate names an imputed ACTOT record; the runtime predicate uses membership in the planned row template, whose ACTOT restriction is supplied by the external PLAN relation rather than this condition.

interpretations: The current Pilot 3 analysis-program description says the earlier outputs were rerun; the ACTOT analysis filter and LOCF endpoint title describe that analysis use, rather than a complete record-imputation algorithm.

The ADRG QC appendix explicitly distinguishes the original CDISC analysis dataset from the current R-generated dataset. Its description of erroneous original LOCF labels is not a competing instruction to label collected current-study records LOCF.

The current-study QC example treats a record directly from QS as non-imputed. It does not define the complete expected ACTOT visit universe, absence criteria after windowing, or which missing slots receive an added row.

The specification reads PLAN for planned rows, sets ROWSRC to one on that template and to zero on collected QS rows, then uses ROWSRC to assign DTYPE. Neither reference DTYPE nor reference-derived PLAN membership establishes an independent documented imputation predicate.

A match to QS by the carried QSSEQ alone cannot classify a record as observed: an imputed record can retain the earlier source sequence. The codelist explains LOCF and permits AVERAGE but supplies no additional AVERAGE assignment rule.

The complete native workbook DTYPE method repeats the citable Define-XML method; no additional governing imputation condition or value-level DTYPE override was found. Its unprojected duplicate and codelist are inventoried separately.
claims.assessment: The output label and fallback are explicit. The implementation substitutes a planned-row indicator for the documented imputed-ACTOT condition; the current-study analyses and QC explanation do not independently define that indicator for every record.
claims.question: Specify the expected ACTOT analysis visits and the source-based criteria for creating imputed records after windowing, then confirm that planned-row membership expresses those criteria.
claims.not_probed_reason: The rule requires an independent predicate identifying an imputed ACTOT record. The retained current-study Define-XML, native workbook and ADRG do not fully state the expected visit universe and absence/eligibility conditions that determine added imputed rows. Using REF.DTYPE would test the result against itself, using reference-derived PLAN membership would import the implementation choice, and raw QSSEQ existence cannot distinguish an observed row from a carried-source imputed row.
